slides.label: Overview
slides.title: OCUMEDA Website
slides.lede: Proposal for the design and Framer implementation of a website restyling based on the new CI, from 9 November to 4 December. Reusable Framer components carry the new style through every page. Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden show more of the actual product, with mockups instead of abstract animations.

items.title: The New CI
points: The new style runs through the whole website: clear and fresh, warm and human, precise without ever feeling clinical.

items.title: Warm Med-tech
points: Approachable and trustworthy: medical expertise with a human face. "Med-tech that radiates warmth".

items.title: A Clearer Story
points: Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden show more of the actual product, with mockups instead of abstract animations.

rows.value: The new CI becomes the website's visual design, on every page. Clear and fresh, warm and human, precise without ever feeling clinical.
Visitors understand the product faster. Storyline, structure and information architecture give Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden a clear, human path.
Every page feels like one brand. Blue and Fog for clarity, Amber and Soft Orange for warmth, type that stays precise rather than clinical.
New pages are faster to build, and the brand stays consistent everywhere. Reusable Framer components carry the style through the whole website, including Team, Karriere and Blog.
Visitors see the product itself. New graphics and product mockups, based on the new brand guidelines and the new photography style.
Home, Ärzte, Optiker and Kunden explain the product with clarity and trust, in a warm, human tone.
Every screen stays clear and comfortable. Breakpoints are checked so the layout holds together.
Text content is supplied by Ocumeda. Writing the copy is out of scope.
Team, Karriere, Blog and other secondary pages get no structural or content changes. Standorte stays a placeholder. The new CI still reaches them through the reusable components.
